question: Related Questions Q. My question is [1] when I am returning to Aziziya on the 7th Zil Haj from Madina when I wear the Ihram at the miqat Zul Hudaifa whether I should make the niyat of Haj of Tamattu only and go to MIna straight away to complete the Haj arkaans or I should again do a Umra and then go to Mina on the 8th of Zil-Haj. When I first came to Mecca from India during Zil Qayida I would have already performed one Umra ss for Haj-e-Tamattu. So is it required to perform another Umra before Haj ? answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 32550 Country: India Title: salaat during hajj Question: Now a days ,many people of knowledge say Meena and Muzdalifa are also included in holy Mecca. So for being Muqeem, 15 days or more stay is counted including stay in Meena and Muzdalifa. What is your opinion ?If counted as one city then , does one day journey of Arafat during 5 days stay of Mina break the continuity provided one return late night back to Muzdalifa ? In fact,last year most of the people counted it as one city and performed salaat accordingly. Answer ID: 32550 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 918/782/B=1432) Mina and Muzdalfah both are two separate places. Both are among the Sha'air of Allah and will remain so till the Day of Judgment. Makkah is a separate city. Mina and Makkah have not been merged together. What people say now that Mina has been merged with Makkah is not true. Deoband and Saharanpur have expressed their opinion about Mina not being combined with Makkah. If you wish, we can send its copy to you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
